messages:
lucy_cs: Quick heads-up — SparkFrame (beta) is blocked from finishing onboarding. They hit an SSO provisioning error plus a schema mismatch when sending sample payloads. Renewal flagged as medium risk if we don't unblock today. Can we triage and run a short enablement workshop?
ashwin_se: I can take the SSO triage. Can you paste the exact error they're seeing?
lucy_cs: Customer pasted this in our shared ticket:```SAMLResponse invalid: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:status:Requester - missing AssertionConsumerServiceURL```
lucy_cs: Also their app logs show 422 on /v1/ingest with payload keys like `user.email` vs `user_email` — simple schema mismatch but they can't advance until SSO is green.
mateo_pm: Plan: split into two threads — (1) 30m enablement walkthrough for their product team (map schema + sample payload) and (2) SE deep-dive on SSO config + IdP metadata. I can own scheduling and recording.
sam_ops: I can run the enablement workshop. I'm free 15:00–16:00 PT today. Is that workable for SparkFrame?
lucy_cs: They're in PST — 15:00 PT works. I'll confirm and send invite with checklist.
ashwin_se: For the SE triage, I'll need their IdP metadata and the exact SAMLResponse. Also please have them run this check command and paste output:```rbx-auth check-saml --org sparkframe --env preview```
lucy_cs: noted. I'll ask them to run it and drop results in this thread.
deploy-bot: [deploy] preview/auth-service v1.2.3 -> v1.2.4 deployed by ci-pipeline at 2026-03-23T18:45:10Z
ashwin_se: flagged — if deploy touched the auth stack this morning it could explain new failures. Will correlate deploy logs.
sam_ops: For the workshop I'll prepare a short runbook: SSO checklist + sample payload mapping + quick validation steps. Link: https://internal.redwood/enablement/sso-and-schema-playbook (will attach slides).
lucy_cs: Thanks. Action items: (1) I'll confirm 15:00 PT and invite SparkFrame + record. (2) Ask customer to paste `rbx-auth` output + SAMLResponse. (3) Ashwin to correlate deploy logs and run IdP repro. (4) Sam to prepare runbook and slides.
mateo_pm: I'll mark this as high priority in the cohort tracker and add renewal touchpoint. If we don't unblock by EOD tomorrow, we'll escalate to account exec.
lucy_cs: Agreed. I'll post a short post-workshop feedback survey link and capture any enablement gaps so we can feed into product. :thumbsup:
ashwin_se: On it. I'll start with deploy logs and report back in 30m.
sam_ops: prepping slides now — will share before the session.
lucy_cs: Great — thanks team, will follow up once the customer confirms.
